sonnet.q3: If its `updated_at` falls in the incremental window (including the 2h lookback), the nightly extract picks it up, stages it in stg_orders, and merges it into fact_orders on `order_id` with the latest version winning.

sonnet.q5: It retries on failure, then pages (alerts) if it still fails.
